title: Our understanding of the business
headline: 1U intends to serve both sides of the utility economy.
intro: 1Utility Bank is introducing Utility Banking, a banking proposition built around the essential services people and businesses depend on, and the organisations and infrastructure that provide them.
consumer: At the consumer level, its defining product is the Utility Account: an account linked to a customer’s phone number that allows money sent by bank transfer to become airtime, data or other supported utility payments.
ecosystem: Around this proposition, 1U intends to provide a broader suite of personal and business banking services, including savings, investments and intelligent security controls.
institutional: On the institutional side, the bank also intends to finance utility providers, assets, infrastructure and renewable-energy projects.
closing: This positions 1U to serve both sides of the utility economy:
sides: The people and businesses that depend on essential services.
The organisations and infrastructure that provide them.
